name: Skills Lab: skills page, add menu, agent editor tabs
description: Covers the Skills Lab section of the sidebar (criteria 6, 9, 11) and the agent editor (35, 30/13 entry point). Data-independent on purpose: the seed creates no skills, so this flow asserts page chrome — heading, subtitle, the Add Skill menu (create vs import) — plus the seeded Security Reviewer, its two-tab editor, and the Skills tab's prompt-order hint. Nothing is created, so no LLM call and no mutation.
